headline: Earnings per share recover sequentially but trail last year
summary_short: EPS of SEK0.6557 compares with a loss of SEK0.13 in the prior quarter and SEK1.06 a year earlier, per Yahoo data.
summary_long: Earnings per share were SEK0.6557, up SEK0.7857 from the prior quarter's loss and down SEK0.4043 from the year-ago quarter. No revenue, margin or cash figures are on the shard for this period, and no drivers are assessed.
